company.name: LoadMe
company.shortDescription: LoadMe is a digital freight platform connecting shippers with transport and logistics providers.
company.description: LoadMe is a UAE-based logistics and freight technology platform connecting shippers with transport providers through digital load-matching solutions. The platform streamlines cargo booking, fleet utilization, shipment tracking, and transportation management for businesses and truck operators. LoadMe aims to improve logistics efficiency, reduce empty truck trips, and enable smarter, technology-driven freight operations across regional supply chains.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform that matches shippers with carriers and manages truck transport operations from order placement to invoicing and payment.
